light.line: Three Waynesville groups, Bathsheba Chapter 14, King Solomon Lodge 15 and UKHFI Temple 203, donated 50 headphones and clothing for elementary nurses' offices on Oct. 20.
BTC Bank surprised the City of Buffalo with a 50,000 dollar check to finish funding the first phase of repairs to the Buffalo Community Center.
A Lebanon church built a wheelchair ramp for a disabled woman, according to the Laclede County Record.
Marshfield nonprofit Shine Through Faith started by mowing yards and running groceries for older neighbors and now helps families, foster kids and teachers too.
A Lake of the Ozarks nonprofit is helping women start over with a safe place to sleep, a working phone, transportation and a fresh chance.
No, Patrick Mahomes does not have a Lake of the Ozarks home; his mom Randi shot down the rumor online, writing she wishes he did because she loves the Lake.
Nearly 2,300 boaters, 2,287 to be exact, turned out under sunny skies for the Fall Harbor Hop poker run to wrap up the Lake of the Ozarks boating season.
Rockin' Rogersville has grown from one night of live music into a full community festival, with all the money raised going back into Rogersville.
